<!-- Use a Conventional Commit title such as `feat(sim): add scenario configuration`. The form is `type(scope): description`, with optional scope and optional `!` for a breaking change. -->

## Summary

<!-- Explain what changed and why. Link the related issue or companion model PR if applicable. -->

## Validation

<!-- List the commands or manual steps you ran and their results. For simulation changes, include the scenario, configuration, and random seed where applicable. Explain any checks you skipped. -->

## Compatibility

<!-- Describe changes to scenario configuration, observations, or reference outputs. Include model-side impact and migration steps for breaking changes. Write N/A if unaffected. -->

## Review checklist

- [ ] The PR title and commit messages follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Validation results and any skipped checks are documented above.
- [ ] Relevant documentation or examples reflect the change, where applicable.
- [ ] Changes that affect the model repository are documented and linked, where applicable.
